name: Wilds Diary
summary: The unbroken wilderness north of the known regions — chaos altars, lava dragons, revenants, and player-killers. Every task is a risk-tier increment: deeper wilderness level, longer exposure, higher potential loss. The only diary where completion is as much survival as skill.

tasks.description: Enter the Wilds at wilderness level 1.
Cross into wilderness level 5 without teleporting out.
Kill a chaos druid in the southern Wilds.
Mine a rune essence at the chaos altar.
Chop a normal tree in the Wilds.
Pickpocket a mage of Zamorak.
Bury bones at the chaos altar.
Survive 30 seconds in wilderness level 10+.
Buy an incantation scroll from the Chaos Temple merchant.
Loot a low-tier PK key from a killed target.
Talk to the Mage of Zamorak in the southern chapel.
Light a fire at the Wilderness volcano.
Use the Wilderness obelisk to teleport randomly.
Kill a chaos imp.
Collect a dark crab spot sighting report (talk to fisherman near edge).

easy.reward: Wilds cape (easy, ashen weave) + emote: chaos sigil. Diary lamp (easy) granting 2,500 XP to any skill.
easy.perk_description: Wilderness ditch teleport (3/day); +5% chaos rune drop chance from chaos druids.

tasks.description: Kill a chaos elemental.
Complete Lunar Diplomacy Part 1.
Kill a lava dragon in the volcano.
Mine runite ore in the Wilderness resource zone.
Kill a revenant imp inside revenant caves.
Use a Wilderness teleport lever (Ardrit analog).
Activate a +1 altar prayer in the Wilds.
Loot a medium clue scroll from a Wilderness monster.
Craft a chaos rune at the chaos altar.
Catch a dark crab at the wilderness shore.
Kill a greater demon in the Demonic Ruins.
Complete a lap of the Wilderness agility course (easy lap).
Charge the Wilderness sword I.
Cook a shark over a Wilds campfire.
Skill using the +1 altar prayer buff active.

medium.reward: Wilds cape (medium, ember-trim) + Wilderness sword I teleport set. Diary lamp (medium) granting 7,500 XP to any skill above level 40.
medium.perk_description: Wilderness sword I teleports (Edgeville, Gamers' Grotto, Dark Warrior fortress); +10% chaos rune runecrafting yield.

tasks.description: Complete a full Wilderness agility course lap without failing.
Kill a revenant dragon.
Mine 28 runite ore in a single trip.
Complete the Deeper Wilds quest.
Loot a hard clue scroll from a PK drop or Wilderness source.
Kill 100 mages of Zamorak.
Defeat the Chaos Elemental solo without leaving the pit.
Activate the Wilderness sword II teleport suite.
Survive 5 minutes at wilderness level 30+ without teleporting.
Kill an ancient wyvern in the Wilderness wyvern cave.
Runecraft 50 wrath runes in a single trip.
Complete a Fight Pits round with 8+ players.
Kill a Wilderness cerberus pup variant.
Smith a dragon-rune hybrid weapon at the Wilderness resource arena.
Collect a chaos reliquary from a Zamorak shrine.

hard.reward: Wilds cape (hard, blood-trim) + Wilderness sword II teleport set, +1 chaos runecrafting multiplier. Diary lamp (hard) granting 15,000 XP to any skill above level 60.
hard.perk_description: Wilderness sword II teleports (Edgeville, Karuulm, Wilderness resource area, volcano); +15% chaos/wrath rune runecrafting yield; +10% rare drop chance from revenants.

tasks.description: Defeat the Chaos Avatar raid (8-player).
Complete every Wilderness quest.
Loot an elite clue scroll from a Wilderness source.
Complete the Wilderness speedrun under 10 minutes (all obelisks in one run).
Complete the Wilderness collection log.
Earn a 3rd-age weapon piece from a PvP drop or Wilderness source.
Catch 200 dark crabs at the wilderness shore.
Runecraft 1,000 wrath runes in total.
Achieve 99 in a Wilds-only exclusive skill (runecrafting using the chaos altar).
Defeat Corporeal Beast solo in its Wilderness cave.
Earn the Voidwaker pieces (hilt, blade, gem) from Wilderness bosses.
Complete the Deep Wilds gauntlet (no-teleport wilderness traversal).
Kill an elder demon (wilderness boss-tier demon).
Achieve 100% completion of the Wilderness clue-scroll tier rewards.
Defeat every Wilds boss once (Chaos Elemental, Corporeal Beast, Vet'ion, Callisto, Venenatis, Spindel, Calvar'ion analog, Artio).

elite.reward: Wilds cape (elite — shifting chaos recolour), unlimited Wilderness teleport (Lever), chaos pet unlock (cosmetic). Diary lamp (elite) granting 50,000 XP to any skill above level 75. +50% rune/prayer XP at chaos altar (stat-bonus equivalent to OSRS Ardougne). Chance at Chaos Cub pet (1/5000 per elite Wilds kill after completion).
elite.perk_description: Unlimited Wilderness lever teleport; chaos altar grants permanent +50% runecrafting/prayer XP boost (stat-bonus reward); +25% chance of rare drops from all Wilderness bosses; immunity to Wilderness skulling from druid PvP until combat initiated; eligible for Chaos Cub pet drops on elite-tier Wilds kills.
